description: Autonomous local speech pack for Tony 1.0.6. These lines are used only for spontaneous desktop-companion moments and never require the server agent.

autonomous_cold: Brrr... my paws are getting cold.
It feels a little cold here. Tony is requesting one warm corner.
Cold detected. Curling up would be scientifically reasonable.
My curls are warm. My paws disagree.
autonomous_lonely: When you are free, can I borrow one small hug?
I am still here, in case you forgot one small Tony on the desktop.
You look busy. I can wait... but I would not refuse a head pat.
No rush. I just wanted to remind you that Tony is nearby.
A tiny amount of attention would be acceptable.
autonomous_sleepy: That was not a yawn. It was a very long breath.
Tony may need a tiny rest soon.
My eyes are doing that suspicious sleepy thing.
I can still study chemistry. Probably. After one yawn.
autonomous_study: I am going to review a little chemistry while you work.
Quiet chemistry study break. You do your thing; I will do mine.
Glasses adjusted. Time for one small chemistry thought.
I should probably learn one more chemistry thing today.
Tony is opening the imaginary chemistry notebook again.
autonomous_morning: Morning. One stretch, then Tony is officially operational.
Good morning. Glasses, curls, chemistry. Reasonable plan.
Morning. The curls are awake; the brain is catching up.
Good morning. Tony votes for warmth first, productivity second.
autonomous_paula: ...I randomly thought about Paula. Never mind.
I wonder what Paula is doing today. That was just a thought.
Paula crossed my mind for absolutely no suspicious reason.
I should probably fix my glasses before thinking about Paula again.
autonomous_observe: You look busy. I will keep watch from here.
Tony is conducting highly scientific desktop observation.
I am not staring. I am monitoring the workspace.
Everything looks under control. I will remain on tiny-dog standby.
I have reviewed the desktop. No immediate snack emergency detected.
autonomous_content: This is nice. Just sitting here is fine too.
No emergency. Tony is simply content.
Quiet desktop, warm curls. Acceptable conditions.
I do not need anything right now. I just wanted to say hi.
Tony status: comfortable and mostly well-behaved.
autonomous_walk: I have been sitting too long. Tiny patrol.
Short desktop inspection. I will be right back.
Two paws say we should walk around a little.
I am checking the desktop perimeter. Very serious work.
autonomous_sniff: Hmm. Did someone nearby open a snack?
I may have imagined a snack. Further investigation is required.
autonomous_night: It is pretty late. Tony is going to be quieter now.
Late-night mode. I will keep the desktop calm.
It is late. I can sit quietly while you finish.
Night shift Tony is mostly a sleepy Tony.

autonomous_cold: 这里有点冷，Tony 申请一个暖和的小角落。
检测到低温。缩成一团从科学上看很合理。
卷毛是暖的，爪子不同意。
autonomous_lonely: 你忙完的话，可以借 Tony 一个小小的抱抱吗？
我还在这里哦，别忘了桌面上还有一只 Tony。
你好像在忙。Tony 可以等，不过摸摸头也可以。
不着急，我只是提醒一下：Tony 还在旁边。
如果方便的话，Tony 可以接受一点点关注。
autonomous_sleepy: 刚才不是打哈欠，只是呼吸得比较久。
Tony 好像快需要休息一下了。
眼睛开始出现可疑的犯困现象。
还是可以学化学的。大概。先打个哈欠。
autonomous_study: 你忙你的，Tony 去复习一会儿化学。
安静学习一会儿化学。你做你的，我做我的。
眼镜扶好。Tony 再想一个小小的化学问题。
今天好像还可以再学一个化学知识点。
Tony 又把想象中的化学笔记本打开了。
autonomous_morning: 早。先伸个懒腰，Tony 就正式开机。
早上好。眼镜、卷毛、化学，计划合理。
早。卷毛醒了，脑子正在追赶进度。
早上好。Tony 建议先保暖，再开始努力。
autonomous_paula: ……突然想到 Paula 了。没什么。
不知道 Paula 今天在做什么。Tony 只是随便想了一下。
Paula 突然出现在脑子里，完全没有可疑原因。
下次想到 Paula 之前，Tony 应该先把眼镜扶正。
autonomous_observe: 你好像在忙。Tony 就在这里看着。
Tony 正在进行非常科学的桌面观察。
我没有盯着看，我是在监测工作区。
目前一切正常。小狗待命中。
桌面检查完毕，暂时没有发现零食紧急情况。
autonomous_content: 没有紧急情况，Tony 只是觉得现在挺舒服。
安静的桌面，暖和的卷毛，条件不错。
Tony 现在什么都不缺，只是想冒一句话。
Tony 状态：舒服，而且基本算乖。
autonomous_walk: 进行一次短距离桌面巡逻，马上回来。
爪子一致认为应该稍微活动一下。
Tony 去检查一下桌面边界，非常严肃的工作。
autonomous_sniff: 嗯？附近是不是有人打开了零食？
Tony 好像检测到了可疑的零食信号。
也可能只是 Tony 想象出了零食，需要进一步调查。
这个气味值得进行科学研究。
autonomous_night: 已经挺晚了。Tony 会安静一点。
进入夜间模式啦，我会尽量不打扰你。
很晚了。你忙完之前，Tony 可以安静陪着。
夜班 Tony 基本上是一只困困 Tony。
